insights.summary: The agent performed a very high-quality analysis of the MoE performance bottlenecks, applying sophisticated memory optimizations. While it was ultimately thwarted by an environment without GPU drivers and a framework crash, the resulting code patch is technically sound and directly addresses the performance goals.
strengths: Strong understanding of PyTorch memory management
weaknesses: Over-invested in fixing the build environment instead of moving to the next optimization
Framework crashed during the final steps
